selected_work: VR_BACKEND_100_REVIEW_SET_05:F18 R105 managed Texture2D per-texture lifetime registry with pre-Unlock staging and post-Unlock HRESULT-gated commit.
summary: R105 maps exact single-mip D3DPOOL_MANAGED Texture2D identities observed by the existing R30 census hooks to CPU shadows. LockRect bytes are copied to owned staging before the real UnlockRect, raw pBits lifetime ends before that COM call, staged bytes commit only after a successful real UnlockRect, failed Unlock invalidates shadow readiness without advancing version, zero-ref Release forgets registry ownership, and successful Reset advances generation while preserving valid CPU shadow content.
